title: Make build process more robust
base_method: Use the selected in-PR repair-predecessor problem commit and its immutable direct parent. The environment-first locate order already exists in the comparison base; this comparison is selected because d6659b1d broadens its consequences by deriving the Verus root, Z3 hint, line-count directory, and verusdoc directory from the selected Verus binary. It must not be represented as the introduction point of environment-first lookup.
source_scope: Complete ostd/ when present at each historical commit, changed files outside ostd/, and root license/notice files. Changed submodules are expanded at their pinned commits.

verification.snapshot_selection: Selected immutable problem/repair-predecessor d6659b1d4f5f505e7f2f17a590fbe1dcbad4764b and its direct parent d67afbc9e914dc05b2a59d8d76d8d22d203badfe. Environment-first lookup already exists in the base; the selected problem broadens its consequences and is not represented as the introduction point.
verification.zero_issues_meaning: Not applicable; this case contains one independently adjudicated semantic tool-selection issue.
verification.source_export: Regenerate the full-index binary diff for d67afbc9e914dc05b2a59d8d76d8d22d203badfe..d6659b1d4f5f505e7f2f17a590fbe1dcbad4764b and byte-check every manifest entry against fixed Git blobs.
verification.tool_result: Two independent reviewers confirmed one semantic tool-selection root at problem d6659b1d and repair 330b824b. The shared locator chooses valid environment paths before repository hints, so stale VERUS_PATH or VERUS_Z3_PATH values displace fixed local tools. The problem commit did not introduce that precedence—it already exists in base d67afbc9—but broadens its impact by deriving Verus-root-relative tools and directories from the selected binary. Repair 330b824b changes the shared order to hints, environment, then PATH. Historical execution was not performed.
